title: TX queue C conformance: consume vector scenario inputs
description: Round-2 security review found behavioral validation pins selected expected labels but ignores the corresponding scenario inputs/operations. A vector can be internally contradictory (for example incoming BULK expected to preempt BULK) and still generate successfully. Validate all behavior-defining scenario paths and generate table-driven inputs/expectations for the C tests, including priority and expiry named cases.
acceptance_criteria: Generator rejects internally inconsistent scenario/expected pairs across bounded, expiry, priority, and implementation vectors; generated C data drives representative expiry, FIFO/alias, preemption, and backpressure operations; negative tests or explicit validation prove scenario mutations fail; sanitizer-backed suite passes.
close_reason: Implemented and verified by host sanitizer suite plus review cycle; superseding round-4 findings are tracked separately
